Miss Fortune

the Bounty Hunter

Miss Fortune is an easy marksman with strong lane trades and one of the most devastating teamfight ultimates in the game. Her Bullet Time can wipe a whole team if they're grouped. She got buffs in patch 26.21, and she's a great champion for learning the bot lane.

When to pick Miss Fortune

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. She's easy to learn and strong in lane, but avoid her into heavy dive.

Pick into

  • Grouped teams for her Bullet Time
  • Short-range marksmen she bullies, like Vayne and Ezreal
  • Teams with crowd control to set up her ultimate

Avoid into

  • Hyper-scaling marksmen, like Kog'Maw and Jinx, who out-damage her late
  • Teams with lots of crowd control that interrupts Bullet Time
  • Assassins who reach her without an escape

Great teammates

RellRell groups enemies for Bullet Time.
BlitzcrankBlitzcrank sets up her kills.
LeonaLeona keeps enemies still for Bullet Time.

Your team needs: Pick Miss Fortune when your team has crowd control to keep enemies in her ultimate.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Strong early trades with Double Up bounces and Love Tap
  • Bullet Time deals huge area damage to grouped enemies
  • Simple kit that's easy to learn
  • Strut gives her lots of move speed to reposition

Weaknesses

  • No dash or escape
  • Bullet Time is a channel: any stun or knock-up cancels it
  • Vulnerable to divers and assassins
  • Less late-game single-target damage than hyper-carries like Jinx

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Q bounce plus Love Tap trades are among the strongest in bot
  • Level 6: Bullet Time can win any fight where the enemies group
  • First item (Bloodthirster): big damage and healing for trades
  • Two items (The Collector): executes low enemies and gives bonus gold per kill
  • Three items (Infinity Edge): Bullet Time crits for massive damage

Top tips

  • Switch targets to trigger Love Tap more often
  • Kill a minion with Q to crit the bounce on the champion behind it
  • Use E to slow enemies before your ultimate
  • Channel Bullet Time from fog or behind walls for surprise
  • Wait for enemy crowd control before ulting
  • Strut gives you speed when you're not being attacked; use it to reposition
